Cached Upload

If i start a search, select a unit, then upload a document, then go back to the mapper home page, then click Begin to start a new search, then find a *different* unit, then continue to the upload screen, the document i uploaded for the initial incomplete map with the original unit is still cached there.

Unsure if this is useful functionality or something a user would want, my guess is that its not - but it could be?
